title: Legitimate Bank Fraud Alert
description: Legitimate automated notification from bank verifying a transaction without asking for secrets, emphasizing that reps never ask for codes.

steps.text: Hello, this is an automated security message from Chase Bank.
Did you attempt a transaction of $42.50 at Trader Joe's today?
If yes, press 1. If no, press 2. Remember, bank representatives will never ask you for your PIN or passcode over the phone.
Thank you for confirming. Your card remains active and secure. Have a great day.
